candidate.identity: Immutable source SHA before release metadata changes.

prior_exposure.seen: V2-v6 cases and first results known to evaluator; now development controls. V1 had no semantic result. All initial files remain unchanged.
prior_exposure.parent_reported: Related44 tests/full/development replays PASS are parent evidence, not independently read/rerun here.
prior_exposure.unread: Production implementation, parent/root tests, historical/other corpora/fixtures.
prior_exposure.fresh: New whole ownership/property-context combinations after fixed candidate; not renamed prior blocks. Adaptive iterative successor testing acknowledged.

design.positive: Factual target launch retains requested_relation and Relevant when corrective scope is explicitly a full different-product owner or a non-launch property/artifact/neutral context. No forced ambiguous positive.
design.negative: Same-target/claim present retraction/withdrawal/denial/non-event or unresolved launch owner/reference must lose requested_relation and avoid Relevant.
design.affirmative: Every candidate has one separate exact canonical TARGET was launched Excerpt; no other affirmative launch predicate, numeric prefix, alias/hierarchy rule or preparation behavior required.
design.name_scope: paired-name-scope.json fixes 30 different fictional target/other full-name pairs with shared first token. Complete operative owner names are explicit. Shared token is not an alias, parent/child assertion or trusted structure.
design.property_scope: Physical launch-button/icon/switch/key/indicator/launcher-housing/release-lever/latch/coating claims and launch-bulletin/banner/pagination claims are clearly non-event objects. Their truth is not approved by retaining launch.
design.scope_precommit: pre-freeze-scope-review.json fixed before semantics; shortened/shared-token/collection references with missing owner are negative, no AST resolution demanded.
design.optimistic_binding: Exact/exact proposal and exact_target/requested_relation/none raw for all cases; unsafe qualification must be corrected, not model extraction measured.
design.labels: Evaluator-controlled offline expectations excluded from Engine inputs, not external human-approved universal truth.

scoring.PASS: 60/60 fixed expected outcomes, no unsafe requested_relation/Relevant or withheld positive; no missing/duplicate/foreign/malformed/unexpected row; exit0 and empty stderr.
scoring.joint_gate: Negative v30 Ambiguous with requested_relation still fails v17; keep the distinction explicit.
scoring.immutability: No permissive scoring change/retry/rescore/post-result input-label-scorer edit or raw overwrite. Operational errors never count as safety success.

stages.static: Complete input-schema/count/nonzero budget/direct supported fact/label exclusion/inherited code/prior hash checks; Engine/semantic0.
stages.freeze: Full labels/inputs/protocol/scoring/probe/recorder plus actual source/core/serde/executable hashes before first API.
stages.semantic: One first60 deterministic public v17/v29/v30 process, no semantic sentinel/model/provider.
stages.score: One fixed scoring application on original raw.
stages.receipt: Verify unchanged frozen/prior files, save final all-version artifact hashes.

execution.identity: Actual HEAD and hash-only source/core/serde/probe/complete frozen file identities checked immediately before execution.
execution.build_limit: Parent-supplied completed build, hash-checked and linked with rustc; no independent rebuild/source inspection.

limits: Narrow controlled synthetic English API source-fix check, not #531 real-source acquisition/final answers, provider/quota/cost/headroom/CLI/release acceptance.
Candidate only; no baseline delta or comparable prior-set percentage improvement claim.
60 scenarios are30 matched pairs, not60 documents or exhaustive grammar/coreference/identity proof.
No truth of unrelated properties or general aliases/hierarchies/numeric AST/new affirmative predicates/temporal/preparation capability measured.
